partners.mechanism_chain: APP (HGNC:603) —DISRUPTS→ Amyloid processing and aggregation (GO:0048042); Amyloid processing and aggregation (GO:0048042) —LEADS_TO→ Neurodegeneration (HP:0002090); IKBKB (HGNC:6073) —DISRUPTS→ IKK signaling pathway (GO:0034097); IKK signaling pathway (GO:0034097) —LEADS_TO→ NF-kappaB signaling pathway (GO:0007245); IKK signaling pathway (GO:0034097) —LEADS_TO→ Severe combined immunodeficiency (HP:0001859); Amyloid processing and aggregation (GO:0048042) —DECREASES→ NF-kappaB signaling pathway (GO:0007245). Both diseases converge on dysregulation of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, leading to distinct but overlapping inflammatory phenotypes.

**Why it matters:** Targeting the NF-kappaB signaling pathway could offer a therapeutic avenue for both Alzheimer disease type 1 and X-linked autoinflammatory disease, although disease-specific modulation would be required to manage the distinct clinical manifestations.
